name_note: Many genomes GTDB places in this genus carry the NCBI label Alistipes, a related genus.

sentences.text: Members of the genus are also reported in animal digestive tracts: a 16S rRNA gene analysis found Tidjanibacter inops_A enriched in the rumen of obese dairy cows.
A study of chickens infected with Eimeria parasites reported that Eimeria necatrix significantly increased the abundance of seven bacterial species, among them Tidjanibacter inops_A.
In mice given a polysaccharide preparation, a study reported increased abundance of Tidjanibacter among beneficial genera at the genus level.
